events.text: Maple & Grain Bakery bakes and ships wholesale bread from our premises at 14 Ferry Street; all deliveries come into the loading dock at the back of that building.

Standing rule: any change to a confirmed standing delivery for a client must be agreed with the account manager Marta Reyes before the client record is altered. If her agreement has not come through, ask her first; do not edit the record.

Standing rule: supplier standing orders live in the orders system. When a supplier changes a delivery arrangement, update the order record to match and confirm the arrangement in writing with the supplier's contact.
